entries.name: sel.hybrid.area
entries.description: Get the cross-section area of a hybrid bolt.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.collection
entries.description: Get the collection ID for this hybrid bolt element. All elements that make up a single bolt will have the same collection ID. The collection ID is assigned with sel hybrid create

entries.name: sel.hybrid.dir
entries.description: Get the orientation of the hybrid bolt element in the global coordinate system.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.dir.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the orientation of the hybrid bolt element in the global coordinate system.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.dowel.dis
entries.description: Get the shear displacement of a dowel.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.dowel.dis.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the shear displacement of a dowel.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.dowel.force
entries.description: Get the shear force on a dowel in global coordinates.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.dowel.force.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the shear force on a dowel in global coordinates.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.dowel.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to hybrid bolt dowel shd in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.dowel.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the hybrid bolt dowel in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.dowel.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the hybrid bolt dowel and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.dowel.length
entries.description: Get the half-length of the dowel.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.dowel.norm
entries.description: Get the orientation of the dowel. The orientation is perpendicular to the crossed joint.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.dowel.norm.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the orientation of the dowel. The orientation is perpendicular to the crossed joint.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.dowel.pos
entries.description: Get the position vector of the dowel, defined as the element centroid.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.dowel.pos.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the position vector of the dowel, defined as the element centroid.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.dowel.sfactor
entries.description: Get the shear factor of a dowel. This is a number between 0 and 2 to give orientation dependent shear strength. See (link required) for details. Default = 1.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.dowel.state
entries.description: Get the Get the dowel state, by indicator. The return values {0, 2, 5,6} indicate not yielding, shear yeild, shear rupture, or host cable rupture respectively.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.dowel.strain
entries.description: Get the shear strain on a dowel.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.dowellist
entries.description: Get the list of dowels associated with this hybrid bolt element. Use the c loop foreach statement to loop through the dowels in the list.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.extra
entries.description: Get/set the data stored in the extra variable at index i for a cable. The value in an extra variable can by any valid FISH type.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.find
entries.description: Get a cable from a given ID.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.force.axial
entries.description: Get the axial force in the hybrid bolt element (tension negative).

entries.name: sel.hybrid.force.thermal
entries.description: Get the axial thermal force in the hybrid bolt element (tension negative).

entries.name: sel.hybrid.fromindex
entries.description: Get a cable from a given index (offset).

entries.name: sel.hybrid.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to hybrid bolt dowel shd in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the hybrid bolt element in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.grout.cohesion
entries.description: Get the grout cohesion.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.grout.friction
entries.description: Get the grout internal friction angle in degrees.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.grout.perimeter
entries.description: Get the grout exposed perimeter.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.grout.stiffness
entries.description: Get the grout stiffness (units of force / displacement).

entries.name: sel.hybrid.head
entries.description: Get the first hybrid bolt element from the hybrid bolt element list.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.index
entries.description: Get the hybrid bolt element ID number.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the hybrid bolt element and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.length
entries.description: Get the length of the hybrid bolt element.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.list
entries.description: Get the list of all cables in the model. This is primarily used in the c loop foreach statement.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.material
entries.description: Get the material property pointer a given hybrid bolt element.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.material.num
entries.description: Get/set the cable material property number for this hybrid bolt element. This can be used to change the property for this hybrid bolt element, but the cable matind function is required to access the material properties.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.next
entries.description: Get the next element on the hybrid bolt element list.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.node
entries.description: Get a node from a cable, given a node number (1 first node; 2 = second node).

entries.name: sel.hybrid.pos
entries.description: Get the position vector of the hybrid bolt element, defined as the element centroid.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.pos.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the position vector of the hybrid bolt element, defined as the element centroid.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.rupture.tension
entries.description: Get the limit axial strain for rupture in tension

entries.name: sel.hybrid.state
entries.description: Get the failure state indicator for a cable element (0 = elastic, 1 = tensile yield, 2 = compressive yield, 3 = axial rupture, 4 = elastic (yield in past), 5 = dowel rupture)

entries.name: sel.hybrid.strain.axial
entries.description: Get the axial strain of the hybrid bolt element (positive: tension; negative: compression).

entries.name: sel.hybrid.stress.axial
entries.description: Get the axial stress of the hybrid bolt element (positive: tension; negative: compression).

entries.name: sel.hybrid.yield.compression
entries.description: Get/set the compression yield strength of the hybrid bolt element.

entries.name: sel.hybrid.yield.tension
entries.description: Get the tension yield strength of the cable (units of force).

entries.name: sel.hybrid.young
entries.description: Get the Young’s modulus of the cable.

entries.name: sel.node.along
entries.description: Get a SEL node along a hybrid bolt. Input the collection ID and the number of the node along the bolt. innum = 1 refers to the start point. innum must be less than the number of segments + 1.

entries.name: sel.node.attach
entries.description: Get/set the attachment condition of a node (true = attached to the grid).

entries.name: sel.node.bond
entries.description: Get/set the state of the bond between the element node and host rock/ soil (1 = intact, 2 = broken, 3 = none).

entries.name: sel.node.collection
entries.description: Get the ID number of a node collection from a given node. A collection refers to a single contiguous structural element, usually created with a single command.

entries.name: sel.node.dis
entries.description: Get the node displacement.

entries.name: sel.node.dis.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the node displacement.

entries.name: sel.node.extra
entries.description: Get/set the data stored in the extra variable at index i for a structural element node. The value in an extra variable can by any valid FISH type.

entries.name: sel.node.find
entries.description: Get a node from a given ID.

entries.name: sel.node.fix
entries.description: Get/set the fixity indicator of the node (false = not fixed (default); true = fixed).

entries.name: sel.node.force
entries.description: Get the node force.

entries.name: sel.node.force.app
entries.description: Get the node applied force.

entries.name: sel.node.force.app.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the node applied force.

entries.name: sel.node.force.shear
entries.description: Get the shear force.

entries.name: sel.node.force.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the node force.

entries.name: sel.node.fromindex
entries.description: Get a node from a given index (offset).

entries.name: sel.node.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to node snp in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: sel.node.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the node in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: sel.node.head
entries.description: Get the first node on the node list. This function should be considered deprecated; it is provided mostly for backward compatibility with old data files. Instead, see the c loop foreach statement and the sel.node.list functions.

entries.name: sel.node.index
entries.description: Get the structural element node ID number.

entries.name: sel.node.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the node and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: sel.node.length
entries.description: Get the length associated with a beam or cable node (half of the average length of connected elements).

entries.name: sel.node.list
entries.description: Get the list of all structural element nodes in the model. This is primarily used in the c loop foreach statement.

entries.name: sel.node.mass
entries.description: Get the node mass

entries.name: sel.node.material
entries.description: Get a pointer to the material assigned to a node.

entries.name: sel.node.near
entries.description: Get the SEL node nearest a given position. If a collection ID is given only nodes from SELs in that collection will be searched.

entries.name: sel.node.next
entries.description: Get the next node on the node list.

entries.name: sel.node.pos
entries.description: Get the node position.

entries.name: sel.node.pos.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the node position.

entries.name: sel.node.vel
entries.description: Get the node velocity.

entries.name: sel.node.vel.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the node velocity.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.b1
entries.description: Get block 1 of a reinforcement element.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.b2
entries.description: Get block 2 of a reinforcement element.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.collection
entries.description: Get the collection ID for a set of reinforcement elements.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.dir
entries.description: Get the direction of a reinforcement element.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.dir.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the direction of a reinforcement element.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.disp.axial
entries.description: Get the axial displacement in a reinforcement element.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.disp.shear
entries.description: Get the shear displacement in a reinforcement element in global coordinates.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.disp.shear.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the shear displacement in a reinforcement element in global coordinates.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.extra
entries.description: Get/set the data stored in the extra variable at index i for a reinforcement element. The value in an extra variable can by any valid FISH type.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.face1
entries.description: Get the first block face to which a reinforcement element is attached.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.face2
entries.description: Get the first block face to which a reinforcement element is attached.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.find
entries.description: Get the reinforcement element from the input ID.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.force.axial
entries.description: Get the axial force in a reinforcement element.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.force.shear
entries.description: Get the shear force in a reinforcement element in the global coordinate system.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.force.shear.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the shear force in a reinforcement element in the global coordinate system.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.fromindex
entries.description: Get the reinforcement element from the input index (offset).

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to reinforcement element srp in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the reinforcement element in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.halflength
entries.description: Get the half-length of a reinforcement element.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.id
entries.description: Get the reinforcement ID number.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.index
entries.description: Get the index on the reinforcement list of a given reinforcement element.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the reinforcement element and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.list
entries.description: Get the list of all reinforcement elements in the model. This is primarily used in the c loop foreach statement.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.material.num
entries.description: Get/set the material number assigned to a reinforcement element.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.next
entries.description: Get the next reinforcement element on the reinforcement element list.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.pos
entries.description: Get the position of the center of the reinforcement element.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.pos.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the position of the center of the reinforcement element.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.rupture.shear
entries.description: Get the ultimate shear strain for the reinforcement element. Shear strain above this value will cause the shear force to drop to 0.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.rupture.tension
entries.description: Get the ultmate tension strain for the reinforcement element. Tension strain above this value will cause the tensile force to drop to 0.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.state
entries.description: Get the state indicator for a reinforcement element. Return a value i ∈ {1, 2, 3, 4, 5} denotes yield in past, shear yielding now, axial yielding now, axial rupture, shear rupture respectively.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.stiffness.axial
entries.description: Get the axial stiffness of the reinforcement element (units of force / displacement)

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.stiffness.shear
entries.description: Get the shear stiffness of a reinforcement element (units of force / displacement).

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.strain.axial
entries.description: Get the axial strain of a reinforcement element.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.strain.shear
entries.description: Get the shear strain of a reinforcement element.

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.yield.shear
entries.description: Get the shear yield strength of a reinforcement element (units of force).

entries.name: sel.reinforcement.yield.tension
entries.description: Get the tensile yield strength of a reinforcement element (units of force).
